reason: The README describes an automated DSH plugin update center that checks npm and GitHub versions, downloads and replaces plugin files, reloads plugins, and reports updates through notifications.

summaries.zh: 自动检查 DSH 插件的新版本，并提供下载、校验、备份替换、热重启和站内通知功能。
summaries.en: Automatically checks DSH plugins for newer versions and provides download, verification, backup replacement, hot reload, and in-app notification workflows.

capabilities: Scans installed DSH plugins and compares versions with npm and GitHub sources
Downloads plugin packages and verifies package integrity
Backs up and replaces plugin files
Runs npm installation or rebuild steps when dependencies change
Hot-reloads updated plugins and restores backups on failure
Performs scheduled update checks and sends in-app notifications
Exposes HTTP endpoints and an AI tool for checking and updating plugins
